name: Roommate Agreement
description: An agreement among the people who share a rented home — who pays what share of the rent, utilities and deposit, what happens when one of them moves out early, how a replacement is found, and how the agreement relates to the lease with the landlord. Distinct from `sublease-agreement`, where one tenant rents to another, and from the residential lease, which the landlord signs.
compliance_matrix_columns: Each person's share of rent and utilities
Each person's share of the security deposit
Relationship to the lease with the landlord
